STUDY 081
Sheer Black Top & Red Mini
Rights check
Source: 24970.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight brown hair
stands against a pale gray seamless backdrop. She
wears a sheer black long-sleeve mesh top with a
keyhole neckline and small black rose appliqués,
layered over a black bralette. Below, a red mini skirt
with a rose appliqué and a small embroidered logo. Tall
black buckled biker boots complete the look. Her
expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light.
Palette of black, red, and pale gray. Bold and sleek, in
the style of a minimal streetwear catalog.
Bold, minimal, sleek
WORKING NOTES
- The red mini and buckled boots create the strongest
contrast.
- Keep the seamless backdrop for a clean catalog look.
